visa_requirement_type: Visa-free entry with free 90-day Visitor Permit on arrival
maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days on the free Visitor Permit issued on arrival
passport_validity_rule: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the intended departure date from Samoa.
blank_passport_pages_rule: No blank-page count is stated in the official visitor-entry checklist reviewed on 15 November 2026.
return_ticket_rule: A confirmed return or onward ticket is required.
proof_of_funds_rule: Documented evidence of sufficient funds for self-support is required, usually a bank statement; no fixed minimum amount is published.
accommodation_rule: Provide a confirmed address. For a hotel or resort give the address; for family or friends give the village and family name.
travel_insurance_rule: No mandatory visitor-insurance policy or minimum cover is stated in the official on-arrival Visitor Permit guidance reviewed.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: Visitors must have no health problems that would pose a risk to Samoa. The published conditions also exclude persons with a deportation record, a criminal history resulting in a sentence of one year or more, or an alert/warning-list match. No destination-specific vaccination rule is stated in the reviewed visitor-entry checklist.
transit_rule: No transit-only visa or permit procedure is stated in the reviewed official visitor guidance. Confirm with Samoa Immigration and the carrier if the itinerary is transit-only and does not involve ordinary visitor entry.
application_channel: Complete the arrival/declaration card and request the free 90-day Visitor Permit from Immigration on arrival at a regulated airport or port. The official fee schedule separately lists a Visitor Entry Permit; its application route and fee scope are not clearly distinguished from the free on-arrival route.
application_fee: SAT$0 on arrival; fee schedule separately lists Visitor Entry Permit SAT$200 (scope not specified).
processing_time: On-arrival permit issued at the border. Fee schedule says Visitor Entry Permit applications take 10 working days; scope is not explicit.
required_documents: Valid ordinary Bangladesh passport, valid at least 6 months after intended departure from Samoa|Completed arrival/declaration card|Confirmed return or onward ticket|Valid visa or permit for the next country of travel|Confirmed accommodation address|Evidence of sufficient funds for self-support, usually a bank statement
review_notes: The official Border services page states that foreign nationals without a valid Temporary Resident Permit or Samoan citizenship receive a free 90-day Visitor Permit on arrival, subject to the listed conditions. The rule is nationality-neutral and applies to holders of an ordinary Bangladesh passport; no Bangladesh-specific exclusion was found. This is a Visitor Permit on arrival, not a visa on arrival, and no advance visa, eVisa or ETA is listed for the standard visitor route. The official Permits page confirms use of the arrival card. The fee schedule separately lists a Visitor Entry Permit at SAT$200 and 10 working days; the public pages do not clearly explain that fee's scope, so it is not attributed to the standard free on-arrival permit. No entry-count limit or transit-only procedure is published. No photo dimensions or photo upload are listed in the reviewed on-arrival checklist.
notes: Visitor Permit holders cannot work. The standard on-arrival Visitor Permit is free for up to 90 days. Entry remains discretionary and subject to return/onward travel, next-country visa, accommodation, sufficient funds, health, character, deportation and alert-list conditions. The SAT$200 Visitor Entry Permit shown in the fee schedule is separately disclosed; its scope relative to the free on-arrival permit requires confirmation before any applicant is told to pay it.
